slice_A/klein/1.label: A: grotesque 1 / shadow 1 / halftone 0
slice_A/klein/1.read: The safe baseline. Reads as the current character with a hard black ground shadow; barely grotesque, barely noir. Works at 124 px, but it is not the direction Tommy asked for.

slice_B/klein/1.label: B: grotesque 2 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
slice_B/klein/1.read: Droopy limbs, crooked yellow teeth and a veiny eye survive at 124 px as a face that is clearly 'wrong'. The shadow went onto the backdrop and the floor, not onto the figure, so it is grotesque with almost no noir.

slice_C/klein/1.label: C: grotesque 2 / shadow 3 / halftone 1
slice_C/klein/1.read: Same as B, a little muddier. Klein ignores 'shadow blocks on the body' and only lights the figure flat. Noir comes out as a floor shadow.

slice_D/klein/1.label: D: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
slice_D/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0, style ref: Real Monsters
slice_D/klein/1.read: Style ref Real Monsters pushes the cheese to a sickly pale yellow with a lumpy face, and this one holds together. Colour is a step off the game's cheese gold (#f5b82a): fixable in the palette stage. Good at 2x, a little flat at 1x.

slice_E/klein/1.label: E: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2
slice_E/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2, style ref: Real Monsters (slice) or Sin City (customer)
slice_E/klein/1.read: Similar to D, with a slightly heavier brow and hatching. Shadow is still on the floor. Safe but not bold.

slice_F/klein/1.label: F: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3
slice_F/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3, style ref: Rocko concept (slice) or Sin City (customer)
slice_F/klein/1.read: Most grotesque of the Klein set, the face is a mess in a good way. The lower arms lost their gloves (cream stumps): a pipeline reject unless fixed.

slice_A/qwen-edit/1.label: A: grotesque 1 / shadow 1 / halftone 0
slice_A/qwen-edit/1.read: Qwen already pushes the grin and the red eyes further than Klein on the safest settings. Keeps the pixel-painted look of the master, so it sits in the current game most easily.

slice_B/qwen-edit/1.label: B: grotesque 2 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
slice_B/qwen-edit/1.read: Fanged grin, bulging red-veined eyes, soft cast shadow behind. Grotesque and still clearly Vinny. One of the best at 124 px because the face has big, high-contrast shapes.

slice_C/qwen-edit/1.label: C: grotesque 2 / shadow 3 / halftone 1
slice_C/qwen-edit/1.read: The closest to what was asked: a solid violet-black block falls across the crust and brow, the lit face stays readable (one eye, fanged grin), and it holds at 124 px and in the street frame. Risk: the block took one eye on this seed, and it is luck rather than control, so it will not repeat on demand.

slice_D/qwen-edit/1.label: D: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
slice_D/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0, style ref: Real Monsters
slice_D/qwen-edit/1.read: The Real Monsters style ref gives a drooling tongue, ruffled crust, thin noodle limbs: the best grotesque. It reads at 1x because the tongue and teeth are large flat shapes. Shadow is still a floor shadow, no blocks on the body.

slice_E/qwen-edit/1.label: E: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2
slice_E/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2, style ref: Real Monsters (slice) or Sin City (customer)
slice_E/qwen-edit/1.read: D with a purple backdrop and more hatching on the cheese; the face is the strongest of the set, with big veiny eyes, a spiralling tongue and a hard shadow on the ground. Halftone is invisible at 124 px.

slice_F/qwen-edit/1.label: F: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3
slice_F/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3, style ref: Rocko concept (slice) or Sin City (customer)
slice_F/qwen-edit/1.read: Most extreme: gloves on the wrong side, wobbly arms. At game size the dots disappear and the cheese becomes noise. Overshoots on faces for a hero.

cust_A/klein/1.label: A: grotesque 1 / shadow 1 / halftone 0
cust_A/klein/1.read: Close to the current art, with a harder jaw. Safe baseline. Reads at 130 px but is plain.

cust_B/klein/1.label: B: grotesque 2 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
cust_B/klein/1.read: Veiny red eyes, flying sweat, big yelling mouth. The expression survives down to 130 px. Shadow is a cast shape on the backdrop behind her, not on her.

cust_C/klein/1.label: C: grotesque 2 / shadow 3 / halftone 1
cust_C/klein/1.read: Wider eyes, more teeth. Reads as 'screaming' at 2x. The pinstripes fall to noise at 1x.

cust_D/klein/1.label: D: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
cust_D/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0, style ref: Real Monsters
cust_D/klein/1.note: extra dangling arm at her right hip on both seeds

cust_E/klein/1.label: E: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2
cust_E/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2, style ref: Real Monsters (slice) or Sin City (customer)
cust_E/klein/1.read: Strongest face of the Klein set: the whites of the eyes and the teeth stay readable. The ink-black outline is already thick. Shadow on the figure is a soft darkening, not a hard block.

cust_F/klein/1.label: F: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3
cust_F/klein/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3, style ref: Rocko concept (slice) or Sin City (customer)
cust_F/klein/1.read: E with yellow hair highlights and heavier lines. About the same, a little more noisy.

cust_A/qwen-edit/1.label: A: grotesque 1 / shadow 1 / halftone 0
cust_A/qwen-edit/1.read: Pixel-painted, close to the current customer. A black floor shadow reaches left, which has to be cropped before it ships.

cust_B/qwen-edit/1.label: B: grotesque 2 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
cust_B/qwen-edit/1.read: Magenta gap between the legs leaks after keying (cleaned here). Face reads, but the pinstripe becomes dotted noise at 130 px.

cust_C/qwen-edit/1.label: C: grotesque 2 / shadow 3 / halftone 1
cust_C/qwen-edit/1.read: Yellow face, bulging eyes, very grotesque; the face has the wrong skin tone for a pipeline that wants a stable palette.

cust_D/qwen-edit/1.label: D: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0
cust_D/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 2 / halftone 0, style ref: Real Monsters
cust_D/qwen-edit/1.note: spotlight cone in the backdrop merges with the figure when keyed, on both seeds

cust_E/qwen-edit/1.label: E: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2
cust_E/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 2, style ref: Real Monsters (slice) or Sin City (customer)
cust_E/qwen-edit/1.read: Bloodshot eyes with veins, spit, a huge scream. The most character of the set, but pinstripes plus eye detail are very busy at 130 px.

cust_F/qwen-edit/1.label: F: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3
cust_F/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque 3 / shadow 3 / halftone 3, style ref: Rocko concept (slice) or Sin City (customer)
cust_F/qwen-edit/1.read: E with more spit; the same strengths and noise.

slice_N1/qwen-edit/1.label: N1: code shadow, soft terminator
slice_N1/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 1 added in code / halftone 0 (base slice_D qwen-edit seed 1)
slice_N1/qwen-edit/1.read: A shadow on the far side of the figure as one flat violet-black block with a hard edge. The face stays lit and readable at 124/130 px. This is the safest way to get Tommy's hard shadow: it is a post pass, so every character in the cast would get the same one.

cust_N1/klein/1.label: N1: code shadow, soft terminator
cust_N1/klein/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 1 added in code / halftone 0 (base cust_E klein seed 1)
cust_N1/klein/1.read: A shadow on the far side of the figure as one flat violet-black block with a hard edge. The face stays lit and readable at 124/130 px. This is the safest way to get Tommy's hard shadow: it is a post pass, so every character in the cast would get the same one.

slice_N2/qwen-edit/1.label: N2: code shadow, hard terminator + dots
slice_N2/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 2 added in code / halftone 1 (base slice_D qwen-edit seed 1)
slice_N2/qwen-edit/1.read: Harder and larger block with a 2 px dot dither along the edge. The dots survive only as a texture at 2x. The shadow now takes a bite of the face, so the light angle would need to be set per character.

cust_N2/klein/1.label: N2: code shadow, hard terminator + dots
cust_N2/klein/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 2 added in code / halftone 1 (base cust_E klein seed 1)
cust_N2/klein/1.read: Harder and larger block with a 2 px dot dither along the edge. The dots survive only as a texture at 2x. The shadow now takes a bite of the face, so the light angle would need to be set per character.

slice_N3/qwen-edit/1.label: N3: code shadow, half the figure + halftone band
slice_N3/qwen-edit/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 3 added in code / halftone 3 (base slice_D qwen-edit seed 1)
slice_N3/qwen-edit/1.read: The bold one: half the figure goes to violet-black and the terminator is a halftone band. It is striking in the street frame, but it eats the second eye and the sneaker on the shadow side. Too much for a hero, plausible for a customer in a doorway.

cust_N3/klein/1.label: N3: code shadow, half the figure + halftone band
cust_N3/klein/1.axes: grotesque from base / shadow 3 added in code / halftone 3 (base cust_E klein seed 1)
cust_N3/klein/1.read: The bold one: half the figure goes to violet-black and the terminator is a halftone band. It is striking in the street frame, but it eats the second eye and the sneaker on the shadow side. Too much for a hero, plausible for a customer in a doorway.
